What is CypherDream?

CypherDream is a biological data sharing and scientific services platform that aims to become the catalyst of the upcoming personalized medicine revolution.

The platform combines the power of blockchain, IPFS and client-side browser data encryption giving the users total control over their datasets and decryption keys.

The system is a completely decentralized peer-to-peer network. It can be used in different devices (PCs, mobile, tablets...) and operating systems (Windows, Linux, Mac) in any modern web browser.
